description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 380 ‘LMNTE Reflective’ adds a hi-vis element to Kanye West’s lifestyle sneaker, featuring slip-on construction designed to hug the foot in lightweight support. Reflective threads are woven into the mostly brown Primeknit upper, accented with mustard yellow coloring throughout the translucent monofilament window. The minimalist build is mounted atop a full-length Boost midsole, wrapped in a semi-translucent cage for added durability. The Yeezy Boost 380 ‘Lmnte Reflective’ is a regional exclusive and only launched in Asia Pacific, Africa, the Middle East, and India.
